description: A dynamic plank-based conditioning exercise strengthening core stability and hip flexors under elevated cardiovascular demands.
setup: Begin in a tall push up plank with hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight, and body forming straight line from head to heels.
steps: Drive right knee rapidly in toward chest without touching right foot to floor.
Quickly drive right leg back to plank while driving left knee vigorously toward chest.
Continue alternating legs in a swift, controlled running rhythm while keeping upper body stable.
cues: Keep hips level with shoulders throughout running pace
Press hands firmly through floor to stabilize shoulder girdle

mistakes.mistake: Hips bouncing high up into the air during switches
mistakes.fix: Brace abdominals firmly to maintain flat tabletop back posture
Keep shoulders stacked directly over wrists to maintain pressing tension

rep_standard: Each completed right and left knee drive pair counts as one repetition
